newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan gold rates seen poised to fall.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan gold rates seen poised to fall.

text.p: Pakistan gold rates are poised to fall as investors switch funds into the dollar to hedge against the eroding rupee, dealers said on Monday.

Local gold closed at 4,938 rupees per 10 grammes on Sunday compared to 4,930 on August 25, even though the central bank lowered the rupee rate to 35.6200/35.7981 to the dollar on Thursday, from 35.5300/35.7077 on August 13.
"Gold rates are likely to ease due to a liquidity crunch," said dealer Saeed Qureshi.
Funds were short in the money market, where overnight rates jumped to 17 percent on Sunday from 2.5 percent on Thursday.
Silver was unchanged in the week ended on Sunday on low demand, said Qureshi, who is also a member of the All Pakistan Gem and Jewellers 'Association.
